messages.text: Every line this package prints should carry the prefix defined in prefix.mjs. format.mjs and report.mjs each build their own line and neither uses it. Make both use the shared prefix, so the suite passes.

response.text:
Now I can see the issue. The tests expect:
- `format("ready")` to return `"[swarm] ready"` (prefix + message with a space)
- `report(3)` to return `"[swarm] 3 finding(s)"` (prefix + count + " finding(s)")

Both functions need to import and use the shared `prefix`.
